fix.ex_en: They tried to stay away from controversial topics at the dinner party.
fix.ex_zh: 晚宴上，他们尽力避免谈论有争议的话题。
fix.notes: a controversial issue—件有争议的事

fix.meaning: v.把……塞进；（为应考）临时死记硬背
fix.ex_en: Lectures were all called off, so students could cram for the semester finals.
fix.ex_zh: 课都取消了，所以学生可以突击复习，准备期末考试。

fix.meaning: v.迁就，放任；沉湎；让……享受一下
fix.ex_en: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
fix.ex_zh: 你不必花大把钱就可以好好犒劳一下自己。
fix.notes: indulgent adj.放纵的，溺爱的 indulge in沉湎于，沉溺于

fix.meaning: v.滥用；虐待 n.滥用；虐待
fix.ex_en: It's easy to abuse one's power.
fix.ex_zh: 人很容易滥用权力。
fix.notes: alcohol abuse酗酒

fix.ex_en: His genius is not confined to maths and physics.
fix.ex_zh: 他的天赋不单体现在数学和物理学上。
fix.notes: 字根gen意为“生（to beget）”，如：genius（生来如此t天才），gene（生物传给后代的东西，遗传的基本单位t基因），regenerate（再生）。

fix.meaning: n.精英人物；精华；上层人士
fix.ex_en: The army was controlled by a small ruling elite.
fix.ex_zh: 军队由少数上层统治精英控制。

fix.ex_en: That student has an aptitude for music.
fix.ex_zh: 那个学生有音乐方面的天赋。
fix.notes: apt adj.恰当的；聪明的

fix.ex_en: These new policies will affect the president's national and international prestige.
fix.ex_zh: 这些新政策将会影响该总统在全国及国际上的声望。
fix.notes: prestigious adj.有名望的，享有声望的 联想记忆：把该词中的i换成a，就变成了“pre+stage”。前缀pre表示“在前”，stage意为“舞台”，站在政治舞台上的人都是有“威望”的。

fix.ex_en: You should know how to respect yourself before you can get respect from others.
fix.ex_zh: 你该先知道如何自尊，然后你才能得到别人的尊重。
fix.notes: respectable adj.可敬的 respectful adj.表示敬意的

fix.ex_en: She is diligent and busy with all kinds of experiments all the time.
fix.ex_zh: 她真勤快，一直都在忙于进行各种实验。
fix.notes: diligent in勤勉于

fix.ex_en: It requires an athlete to have great skill, cool nerves and quick reflexes.
fix.ex_zh: 那需要运动员有高超的技巧、冷静的头脑和迅速的反应能力。
fix.notes: skilled adj.有技能的，熟练的 skilful adj.巧妙的；娴熟的

fix.ex_en: I have to submit this report to my lecturer.
fix.ex_zh: 我得把这份报告交给讲师。
fix.notes: lecture n.演讲，讲课v.开讲座，讲课

fix.ex_en: They are interviewing candidates for the position of sales manager.
fix.ex_zh: 他们正在面试应聘销售经理职位的求职者。
fix.notes: 字根cand表示“白（white）”，如candle（变白，发光t蜡烛）和candid（白，纯t坦诚的）。而candidate的来历要说到古罗马，当时要去竞选公职的人要穿白色宽外袍。

fix.ex_en: You can't work here without a work permit.
fix.ex_zh: 你没有工作许可证就不能在这里工作。

fix.meaning: n.大学毕业生；［美］（大学、中学等的）毕业生 v.大学毕业；［美］中学毕业
fix.ex_en: Preference will be given to graduates in journalism.
fix.ex_zh: 新闻专业的大学毕业生将获得优先考虑。
fix.notes: graduation n.毕业 undergraduate n.本科生 postgraduate n.研究生 graduate student n.研究生 graduate from从...毕业 grad（步，级）+uate（后缀）t达到一定级别，获得学位T毕业。

fix.meaning: n.［美］（大学或高中）二年级学生
fix.ex_en: My sophomore year at college was perhaps the most remarkable year of my life.
fix.ex_zh: 我上大二的那年也许是我生命中最不同寻常的一年。

fix.meaning: n.［美］（大学或高中）毕业班学生；较年长者 adj.成人的；级别（或地位）高的
fix.ex_en: The seniors defeated the juniors by 4-2.
fix.ex_zh: 大四学生以4比2战胜了大三学生。
fix.notes: senior high school（美国）高中

fix.meaning: n.［alumnus的复数形式］毕业生，校友
fix.ex_en: My alumni and alumna are present at my birthday party.
fix.ex_zh: 我的校友们都出席了我的生日聚会。
fix.notes: alumna n.女毕业生，女校友

fix.meaning: v.登记，注册 n.登记表，注册簿
fix.ex_en: You must register for the tax.
fix.ex_zh: 你必须为纳税进行登记。
fix.notes: registration n.登记，注册；挂号

fix.ex_en: I am on the roster for tomorrow night.
fix.ex_zh: 我被排在明晚执勤。

fix.ex_en: They enrolled that freshman as a member of the club.
fix.ex_zh: 他们招收了那个大一新生为俱乐部会员。
fix.notes: enrolment（=enrollment）n.入学（人数）；注册（人数）；登记（人数） enrol on a course注册学习一门课程 en（进入，使）+rol（卷轴）t使之登记在册。

fix.ex_en: The data should be updated once a week.
fix.ex_zh: 这些数据应该每星期更新一次。

fix.ex_en: Literature stands related to man as scienee stands to nature.
fix.ex_zh: 文学与人的关系正如科学与自然的关系一样。
fix.notes: literary adj.文学（上）的

fix.ex_en: The editor asked him to contribute a weekly article on European affairs.
fix.ex_zh: 编辑让他每周写一篇有关欧洲情况的文章。

fix.ex_en: Her diary is full of entries about him.
fix.ex_zh: 她的日记里记了许多关于他的事情。

fix.ex_en: I myself enjoy cinema, drama, poetry and travelling.
fix.ex_zh: 我本人喜欢电影、戏剧、诗歌和旅行。
fix.notes: poem n.诗 poet n.诗人

fix.ex_en: One of my friends likes to read biographies of great men to enhance himself.
fix.ex_zh: 我的一个朋友喜欢读伟人传记来提高自己。

fix.ex_en: The subjects in the research were asked to keep a record of everything they ate for a week.
fix.ex_zh: 研究对象被要求记录下自己一周内所吃的所有食物。
fix.notes: recorder n.记录员；录音机，录像机

fix.ex_en: When the first draft was completed, she took a break.
fix.ex_zh: 当初稿完成以后，她休息了一会儿。

fix.meaning: n.内容；目录；含量 adj.满足的
fix.ex_en: The calorie content in a regular Coke is very high.
fix.ex_zh: 一罐普通可乐里的卡路里含量很高。
fix.notes: be content with对...满足

fix.meaning: n.指数；指标；索引v.为……编索引
fix.ex_en: The index is arranged in alphabetical order.
fix.ex_zh: 这索引是按字母顺序排列的。

fix.ex_en: You can look for the book in the library catalogue.
fix.ex_zh: 你可以在图书馆的图书目录上查找这本书。

fix.ex_en: We made an inventory of everything in the old museum.
fix.ex_zh: 我们针对这家老博物馆的所有藏品列了张清单。

fix.ex_en: He strongly objects to getting up early.
fix.ex_zh: 他强烈反对早起。
fix.notes: objection n.反对 objective adj.客观的 字根ject表示“投掷（to throw）”，如：ob（相反）+ject（投掷）t object（反对）:e（向外）+ject（投掷）—eject（逐出；喷射；［磁盘等］弹出）；pro（向前）+ject（投掷）+or（东西）t projector（投影仪）。

fix.ex_en: A company's accounting records must be open for inspection at all times.
fix.ex_zh: 公司的会计账目必须可以随时公开供人检查。
fix.notes: account n.账户 accountant n.会计师

fix.ex_en: There is a compulsory course in statistics.
fix.ex_zh: 有一门统计学的必修课。

fix.ex_en: Biology is the study of living things.
fix.ex_zh: 生物学是对生物的研究。
fix.notes: biological adj.生物的；生物学的

fix.ex_en: I have a good command in the procedures of logistics.
fix.ex_zh: 我对物流的每个步骤都很熟悉。

fix.ex_en: That country wants to increase tariffs on items such as electronics.
fix.ex_zh: 那个国家打算增加电子器件等产品的关税。
fix.notes: electron n.电子 electronic adj.电子的；电子学的 electrical adj.电的；电气科学的 electricity n.电；电流；电学

fix.ex_en: Arab brought arithmetic and algebra to the fore once again and placed it almost on a par with geometry.
fix.ex_zh: 阿拉伯人把算术和代数又一次提高到几乎和几何并驾齐驱的地位。

fix.meaning: prep.加上 adj.正（数）的，在零以上的
fix.ex_en: Intelligence plus wit makes for an interesting person.
fix.ex_zh: 智慧加上机智就会造就一个有趣的人。

fix.ex_en: The yolk contains all the fat and approximately half the protein of the egg.
fix.ex_zh: 蛋黄含有鸡蛋中全部的脂肪和大约一半的蛋白质。
fix.notes: proximity n.接近

fix.ex_en: This chart displays the links connecting these groups.
fix.ex_zh: 这张图显示出这些群体之间的关联。

fix.ex_en: The plate itself is a small rectangle made of gold.
fix.ex_zh: 这只盘子本身就是个黄金制的小长方形。

fix.ex_en: The three places form a triangle.
fix.ex_zh: 这三个地方构成一个三角形。

fix.ex_en: The police have sectioned off the road with traffic cones.
fix.ex_zh: 警察用锥形路标把这条路隔了出来。
fix.notes: 最常见的圆锥体是我们在吃冰激凌时可见到的蛋卷做成的用来盛冰激凌球的cone，ice cream cone即“蛋卷冰激凌，圆筒冰激凌”。

fix.ex_en: I am per cent in agreement.
fix.ex_zh: 我百分之百同意。

fix.ex_en: This door is very narrow in proportion to its height.
fix.ex_zh: 就其高度而言，这扇门太窄了。

fix.ex_en: The mercury stood at nearly 40°C.
fix.ex_zh: 水银柱几乎升到了40摄氏度。
fix.notes: 墨丘利（Mercury）是罗马神话中的神。他天生飞毛腿，在有关他的艺术作品中，他经常被描绘为戴着有翅膀的头盔或穿着有翅膀的鞋子。墨丘利自然成了在众神间传递消息的信使，也成了商业、贸易甚至盗窃之神。有趣的是，水星是太阳系八大行星中离太阳最近的一颗，绕太阳的公转平均速度最快，用跑得最快的神来命名真是再贴切不过了。

fix.meaning: v.散发（光、热、气等）；发出（声音）
fix.ex_en: The tail exhaust pipe of the car emitted poisonous smoke.
fix.ex_zh: 汽车的尾部排气管排出了有毒的烟。
fix.notes: emission n.（光、热、气等的）散发，放射，释放

fix.ex_en: If you leave your metal tools outside in the rain, they will rust.
fix.ex_zh: 如果你在雨天把金属工具放在外面，它们会生锈的。
fix.notes: rusty adj.生锈的

fix.meaning: adj.（影响）深刻的，深远的；见解深刻的
fix.ex_en: His brother's words have had a profound effect on him.
fix.ex_zh: 他哥哥的话对他产生了深刻的影响。

fix.meaning: n.（布置的）作业；（分派的）任务
fix.ex_en: A brave fighter never shrinks from danger when executing an assignment.
fix.ex_zh: 一个英勇的战士在执行任务时决不害怕危险。

fix.ex_en: The writer was revising what he had written.
fix.ex_zh: 这名作家正在修改他所写的东西。
fix.notes: revision n.修订，修改

fix.ex_en: Each child had to recite a poem in class.
fix.ex_zh: 每个孩子都得在课上背诵一首诗。
fix.notes: recitation n.背诵，朗诵；逐一列举；背诵的诗文

fix.ex_en: There is a presentation of our new play tonight.
fix.ex_zh: 今晚，我们有一出新戏上演。
fix.notes: present v.呈现 n.礼物 adj.在场的 presence n.在场 give a presentation of就...进行陈述

fix.ex_en: The science fiction fascinates the readers from the outset.
fix.ex_zh: 这部科幻小说从开头就引人入胜。

fix.ex_en: These documents provided a broad outline of the country's development after World War II.
fix.ex_zh: 这些文件勾画出了该国在第二次世界大战后的大致发展情况。

fix.ex_en: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880.
fix.ex_zh: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。
fix.notes: introduction n.介绍；引进 introduce oneself自我介绍 introduce sb. to sb.介绍某人认识另一个人

fix.ex_en: I'll just cite some figures for comparison.
fix.ex_zh: 我要引用一些数字来进行比较。

fix.ex_en: At last, we elicited some important information from him.
fix.ex_zh: 最终，我们从他那里探得了一些重要的信息。

fix.ex_en: The following extract is taken from his commentary on the movie.
fix.ex_zh: 下面一段摘自他对这部电影的评论。
fix.notes: extraction n.取出 ex（向外）+tract（拉）t抽出来的一块t摘录。

fix.meaning: n.摘要 adj.抽象的 v.提取；把...抽象出
fix.ex_en: Iron is abstracted from ore.
fix.ex_zh: 铁是从矿石中提取的。
fix.notes: abstracted adj.心不在焉的，出神的 abstraction n.抽象 abstract sth. from sth.从某物中提炼出某物

fix.ex_en: Let us suppose another planet with conditions similar to those on the earth.
fix.ex_zh: 让我们假定有另外一个和地球上的条件相似的行星。
fix.notes: be supposed to do/be sth.（按习惯、规定等）应该做某事/是某事物

fix.ex_en: This is only a scientific hypothesis which has not been proved by experiments.
fix.ex_zh: 这仅仅是一个尚未被实验证明的科学假说。

fix.ex_en: Her diligence has set an example to the others.
fix.ex_zh: 她的勤奋为其他人树立了榜样。
fix.notes: exemplify v.举例说明，作为...的例证（或榜样、典型等） for example例如

fix.ex_en: Nowadays, we can read many instances of good people and good deeds in the press.
fix.ex_zh: 如今，人们能从报刊上看到很多关于好人好事的实例。
fix.notes: for instance例如

fix.ex_en: Her bravery manifests itself in times of difficulties.
fix.ex_zh: 在困难时期，她的勇气显现了出来。

fix.ex_en: He determined to move to another city and start a new life.
fix.ex_zh: 他决心搬去另一座城市，开启新生活。
fix.notes: determinant n.决定因素 determined adj.下定决心的 determine to do sth.决心做某事 determine beforehand事先决定

fix.meaning: n.民意调查 v.对……进行民意调查
fix.ex_en: A recent survey of public opinions shows that many people are worried about the rising house prices.
fix.ex_zh: 最近的一份民意调查表明，很多人对不断上涨的房价表示忧虑。

fix.ex_en: We must inquire into the matter.
fix.ex_zh: 我们必须调查此事。
fix.notes: inquiry n.询问；调查 inquire into调查

fix.meaning: n.分数；标记 v.标志着；给……打分；在……上做记号
fix.ex_en: It is dangerous to swim beyond this mark.
fix.ex_zh: 游泳时超过这个标记就有危险了。

add.ex_en: He is behaving like a perfect idiot.
add.ex_zh: 他表现得像一个十足的白痴。

add.ex_en: I like his approach to the problem.
add.ex_zh: 我喜欢他解决这个问题的方法。

add.meaning: n.［美］（大学或高中）三年级学生；较年幼者 adj.成人的；级别（或地位）较低的
add.ex_en: At that time, I was a sophomore and Miss Yang was a junior.
add.ex_zh: 当时，我是二年级学生，而杨小姐是三年级学生。

add.ex_en: The police have a file on him.

add.meaning: n.概述；人物简介；侧面轮廓
add.ex_en: Her beautiful profile impressed the judges very much.
add.ex_zh: 她漂亮的侧面轮廓给评委们留下很深的印象。

add.ex_en: There are different categories of books in a library.
add.ex_zh: 图书馆里有不同种类的书。

add.meaning: n.上下文，语境；背景，来龙去脉
add.ex_en: We should judge the past in its historic context.
add.ex_zh: 我们应当根据时代背景来评判过去的事。

add.meaning: n.一览表，目录 v.列举；把……列表
add.ex_en: The results are listed in numerical order.
add.ex_zh: 结果是按数字顺序列出的。

add.meaning: n.（书等的）章；（人生或历史的）重要时期
add.ex_en: Steamboat travel opened a new chapter in America's exploration of the West.
add.ex_zh: 汽船旅行为开发美国西部翻开了新篇章。

add.ex_en: They worked all day without a break and finished the audit on time.
add.ex_zh: 他们不停地工作了一整天，按期完成了审计工作。

add.ex_en: I'd like to introduce you to my geography professor.
add.ex_zh: 我想介绍我的地理学教授给你认识。

add.ex_en: Geometry is a piece of cake for me but a big headache for my friend Claire.
add.ex_zh: 几何学对我来说是小菜一碟，但是让我的朋友克莱尔很头疼。

add.ex_en: They made a graph of how cold the weather was every day for a month.
add.ex_zh: 他们制作了一张图表，显示了一个月内每天天气有多冷。

add.ex_en: You can charge your car battery in this car park.
add.ex_zh: 你可以在这座停车场给你的汽车蓄电池充电。

add.ex_en: He is too superficial to appreciate great literature like this.
add.ex_zh: 他太肤浅，无法欣赏这类文学巨著。

add.meaning: v.让（某人）听写；命令，强行规定
add.ex_en: The English teacher dictates to the class every other week.
add.ex_zh: 英语老师每隔一周就给这班学生做一次听写。

add.ex_en: It is a good idea to do some research before you buy a house.
add.ex_zh: 买房子之前先进行调查，这是个好主意。
add.notes: researcher n.调查者；研究人员 do research进行调查
